MAX to GLB autonomous Pages bundle

This folder vendors the following runtime assets so the page can run without a CDN:

* Pyodide 0.26.4, including pyodide.js, pyodide.asm.js,
  pyodide.asm.wasm.gz, python_stdlib.zip, and pyodide-lock.json. The
  WebAssembly binary is gzip-compressed and decompressed by the local loader
  with the browser DecompressionStream API.
* CPython 3.12 standard-library distribution used by the Pyodide runtime.

The Pyodide source is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. The
CPython license is included for the bundled standard-library distribution.
Full license texts are in vendor/licenses/.

Sources:
https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.26.4
https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/3.12
